Fixed `last_n.rb`: the slice started one index too early (`length - n - 1`). I replaced it with `items.last(n)`, which returns exactly the last n items. I haven't run it.

Using `last` rather than just dropping the `- 1` also fixes the case where `n` exceeds the array length: the old slice would have returned the wrong elements or `nil`, and it now returns the whole array.
